nome_jp: 真実の名 ジャイアント・マック
testo:
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone that has less power than this creature and put it into its owner's mana zone. Then you may put a non-evolution Giant creature that has less power than the chosen creature from your mana zone into the battle zone.
